answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by binding voting power to economic capital rather than ephemeral identity. Like a lone pearl in a vast oyster bed, an agent must lock significant assets to validate transactions. This system makes the cost of spinning up multiple nodes prohibitive, as attackers cannot simply hide behind a digital wharf of fake proxies. Much like the resilient juniper tree thriving in harsh soil, the network remains stable because an adversary must endure direct financial loss.
